SECTION_DESC: Tip: put the folders you want into one playlist (audiobooks and podcasts simply stay out) and use the shuffled copy as a personal radio. Choose a saved playlist. A copy with randomly ordered tracks will be created and ' shuffle' added to its name. Running it again on the same playlist re-shuffles the copy. Every track plays once per pass and Previous works normally. Recommended: use together with an autostart plugin that remembers and resumes the queue, so tracks do not repeat after a restart.
CREATE_BTN_DESC: The original playlist is not changed
ERR_EMPTY: The playlist is empty or unreadable
ERR_WRITE: Could not save the new playlist
